description: Identifier-exact path:line set over this repo's own source. Labels were written by reading the code at the pinned commit, not by running the resolver. expect: block (each listed path:line comes with its whole block), pointers (exactly these path:line, no body), empty (nothing). A name the index can't match exactly, like a string literal or a typo, is labeled empty even when a human could guess the place: the resolver must not guess.
index: every git-tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.py/.go file at the commit
split: held-out when FNV-1a(id) % 3 == 0, dev otherwise; tune only on dev
